title: A Time Limit with a Warning

args: const s = []; const v = await limitTime(later(5, "data"), 30, () => s.push("expired")); await later(55); return [v, s];
const s = []; await limitTime(later(50), 20, () => s.push("expired")).catch(() => s.push("caught")); return s;
const s = []; const p = limitTime(failLater(5, "bad"), 30, () => s.push("x")); await p.catch(() => {}); await later(55); return s;
